title: Composed run agrees with the first machine
statement: Let $M_1$ and $M_2$ be deterministic machines with $k$ work tapes and a common input alphabet, with state sets $S_1$ and $S_2$. Form a machine on $S_1\sqcup S_2$ that follows $M_1$ on left states, switches from the specified exit state to the specified entry state in one step without changing the tapes, and follows $M_2$ on right states. If a run of $M_1$ from configuration $c$ avoids the exit state at every time $t<T$, then for every $t\le T$ the composed machine, started from $c$ with its state placed in the left component, is exactly the configuration reached by $M_1$ at time $t$, with its state placed in the left component.
hypotheses_covered: $M_1,M_2$ are machines with $k$ work tapes and common symbol alphabet
At every time $t<T$, the run from $c$ does not have state $exit$
$t$ is a natural number with $t\le T$
